```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(plotly)
library(leaflet)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)


# Read in Data

locations <- read_csv("data/locations.csv")
visits <- read_csv("data/All National Parks Visitation 1904-2016.csv")
state_pop <- read_csv("data/state_pop.csv")
gas <- read_csv("data/gas_price.csv")
national_parks <- read_csv("data/national_parks.csv")

# Clean data and merge with state populations
visits_clean <- visits %>% 
  rename(visitors = Visitors,
         year = YearRaw,
         state = State,
         gnis_id = `Gnis Id`,
         park_name = `Unit Name`) %>% 
  mutate(year = as.numeric(as.character(year)),
         gnis_id = as.character(gnis_id)) %>% 
  group_by(gnis_id, state, year, park_name) %>% 
  summarize(visitors = sum(visitors, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(gnis_id), !is.na(year))

park_data <- visits_clean %>% 
  left_join(gas, by = "year") %>% 
  rename(gas_price = gas_current) %>% 
  select(-gas_constant)
  
park_data <- park_data %>% 
  left_join(state_pop, by = c("state" = "state", "year" = "year")) %>% 
  rename(state_population = pop)

locations_clean <- locations %>% 
  mutate(gnis_id = as.character(gnis_id))

park_data <- locations_clean %>% 
  right_join(park_data, by = "gnis_id") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(lon),
         !is.na(lat),
         !is.na(state_population),
         !is.na(gas_price)) %>% 
  mutate(lon = as.numeric(lon), lat = as.numeric(lat)) %>% 
  select(lon, lat, park_name, state, year, visitors, state_population, gas_price)

years_available <- sort(as.numeric(unique(park_data$year)))
max_visitors <- max(park_data$visitors, na.rm = TRUE)


# Ely Cleaned

park_visits <- read_csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2019/2019-09-17/national_parks.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Keep only National Parks with non-missing visitors
park_visits <- park_visits %>% 
  filter(unit_type == "National Park") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(visitors)) %>% 
  mutate(year_num = as.numeric(year))   

# IM region, years >= 2000 (no total rows)
im_parks <- park_visits %>% 
  filter(region == "IM",
         !is.na(year_num))

#grand total
im_total <- im_parks %>% 
  group_by(year_num) %>% 
  summarise(visitors = sum(visitors), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(unit_name = "Total Visitation")

im_parks <- bind_rows(im_parks, im_total)

# Vector of IM park names for the dropdown
im_park_list <- sort(unique(im_parks$unit_name))

```

### **About the Data**

This dashboard uses data from the **TidyTuesday National Parks Visitation dataset** (2019-09-17 release), which contains annual visitor counts to U.S. National Parks from 1904–2016. Additional data on state populations and entrance fees are included to enable regional and temporal comparisons.

### **Purpose of the Dashboard**

The dashboard allows users to explore:
- Total annual visitation trends over time  
- Differences in visitation by U.S. region  
- Park-level visitation trends across different eras  
- Interactive views of individual park visitation patterns  

### **How to Navigate**

Use:
- The **sidebar controls** to filter years or regions  
- The **interactive plots** (hover to see values)  
- Tabs and rows to explore different panels in the dashboard

    clearMarkers() %>% 
    addCircleMarkers(
      lng = ~lon,
      lat = ~lat,
      radius = ~radius,
      fillColor = "#1f78b4", 
      color = "#000000",
      weight = 0.5, 
      opacity = 1, 
      fillOpacity = 0.8, 
      popup = ~popup_html
    )
})

```{r aqi_data_setup}
# Load and prepare air quality data
air <- read_csv("data/Air quality.csv")

# Intermountain region states
im_states <- c("Montana", "Wyoming", "Utah", "Colorado",
               "Arizona", "New Mexico", "Texas", "Oklahoma")

# State abbreviation mapping
state_map <- c("MT" = "Montana", "WY" = "Wyoming", "UT" = "Utah", 
               "CO" = "Colorado", "AZ" = "Arizona", "NM" = "New Mexico",
               "TX" = "Texas", "OK" = "Oklahoma")

# Calculate ACTUAL median AQI by dividing by reporting counties
air_im <- air %>%
  filter(State %in% im_states) %>%
  rename(
    year = Year,
    state = State,
    counties_reporting = `Cnty_Rpt`,
    raw_median_aqi = `Median AQI`,  # This is actually a SUM across counties
    good_days = `Good Days`,
    moderate_days = `Moderate Days`,
    unhealthy_days = `Unhealthy Days`,
    hazardous_days = `Hazardous Days`
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(raw_median_aqi), counties_reporting > 0) %>%
  # Calculate the actual average median AQI across counties
  mutate(
    median_aqi = round(raw_median_aqi / counties_reporting, 1),
    # EPA AQI categorization based on corrected Median AQI
    aqi_category = case_when(
      median_aqi <= 50  ~ "Good",
      median_aqi <= 100 ~ "Moderate",
      median_aqi <= 150 ~ "Unhealthy (Sensitive)",
      TRUE ~ "Unhealthy"
    ),
    aqi_color = case_when(
      aqi_category == "Good" ~ "#00E400",
      aqi_category == "Moderate" ~ "#FFFF00",
      aqi_category == "Unhealthy (Sensitive)" ~ "#FF7E00",
      TRUE ~ "#FF0000"
    )
  )

# ===== FIX #2: Use the SAME park source as teammate (TidyTuesday) =====
# Filter to IM region National Parks only, matching teammate's im_parks
parks_im_coords <- park_visits %>%
  filter(region == "IM", unit_type == "National Park") %>%
  distinct(unit_name) %>%
  # Add coordinates - using a manual lookup for major IM National Parks
  # This ensures consistency and correct locations
  mutate(
    lon = case_when(
      unit_name == "Yellowstone National Park" ~ -110.5885,
      unit_name == "Grand Teton National Park" ~ -110.6818,
      unit_name == "Rocky Mountain National Park" ~ -105.6836,
      unit_name == "Mesa Verde National Park" ~ -108.4618,
      unit_name == "Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park" ~ -107.7416,
      unit_name == "Great Sand Dunes National Park" ~ -105.5943,
      unit_name == "Arches National Park" ~ -109.5925,
      unit_name == "Bryce Canyon National Park" ~ -112.1871,
      unit_name == "Canyonlands National Park" ~ -109.8782,
      unit_name == "Capitol Reef National Park" ~ -111.2615,
      unit_name == "Zion National Park" ~ -113.0263,
      unit_name == "Grand Canyon National Park" ~ -112.1401,
      unit_name == "Petrified Forest National Park" ~ -109.7890,
      unit_name == "Saguaro National Park" ~ -110.7574,
      unit_name == "Carlsbad Caverns National Park" ~ -104.5567,
      unit_name == "Big Bend National Park" ~ -103.2502,
      unit_name == "Guadalupe Mountains National Park" ~ -104.8606,
      unit_name == "Glacier National Park" ~ -113.7870,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    lat = case_when(
      unit_name == "Yellowstone National Park" ~ 44.4280,
      unit_name == "Grand Teton National Park" ~ 43.7904,
      unit_name == "Rocky Mountain National Park" ~ 40.3428,
      unit_name == "Mesa Verde National Park" ~ 37.2309,
      unit_name == "Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park" ~ 38.5754,
      unit_name == "Great Sand Dunes National Park" ~ 37.7916,
      unit_name == "Arches National Park" ~ 38.7331,
      unit_name == "Bryce Canyon National Park" ~ 37.5930,
      unit_name == "Canyonlands National Park" ~ 38.3269,
      unit_name == "Capitol Reef National Park" ~ 38.0877,
      unit_name == "Zion National Park" ~ 37.2982,
      unit_name == "Grand Canyon National Park" ~ 36.0544,
      unit_name == "Petrified Forest National Park" ~ 34.9100,
      unit_name == "Saguaro National Park" ~ 32.2967,
      unit_name == "Carlsbad Caverns National Park" ~ 32.1479,
      unit_name == "Big Bend National Park" ~ 29.2500,
      unit_name == "Guadalupe Mountains National Park" ~ 31.8913,
      unit_name == "Glacier National Park" ~ 48.7596,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    state_full = case_when(
      unit_name %in% c("Yellowstone National Park", "Grand Teton National Park") ~ "Wyoming",
      unit_name %in% c("Rocky Mountain National Park", "Mesa Verde National Park", 
                       "Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park", "Great Sand Dunes National Park") ~ "Colorado",
      unit_name %in% c("Arches National Park", "Bryce Canyon National Park", "Canyonlands National Park",
                       "Capitol Reef National Park", "Zion National Park") ~ "Utah",
      unit_name %in% c("Grand Canyon National Park", "Petrified Forest National Park", 
                       "Saguaro National Park") ~ "Arizona",
      unit_name == "Carlsbad Caverns National Park" ~ "New Mexico",
      unit_name %in% c("Big Bend National Park", "Guadalupe Mountains National Park") ~ "Texas",
      unit_name == "Glacier National Park" ~ "Montana",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat))

# Years for slider
aqi_years <- sort(unique(air_im$year))
```

### EPA AQI Categories

**About the Data**    
This section uses EPA Air Quality Index (AQI) data aggregated at the state level, combined with the TidyTuesday National Parks dataset. AQI values are averaged across all reporting counties per state and categorized using EPA standards: Good (0–50), Moderate (51–100), Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups (101–150), and Unhealthy (151+).

**Purpose of the Section**     
This panel allows users to explore:     

Air quality conditions at Intermountain Region National Parks over time
State-level AQI trends and how they relate to park visitation
Which parks may experience poorer air quality in a given year

**How to Navigate**    
Use:

- The year slider to view AQI conditions for a specific year.
- Plot showing visits per year.
- The interactive map (click markers for park details).    
- The summary table to compare AQI and visitation across states.    

Column {data-width=750}

### Park Air Quality Map

```{r aqi_map}
# Reactive: filter AQI and join with parks
parks_aqi_data <- reactive({
  req(input$aqi_year)
  
  aqi_year <- air_im %>% 
    filter(year == input$aqi_year) %>%
    select(state, median_aqi, aqi_category, aqi_color, 
           good_days, unhealthy_days, hazardous_days, counties_reporting)
  
  parks_im_coords %>%
    left_join(aqi_year, by = c("state_full" = "state")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(aqi_category))
})

# Render map
leafletOutput("aqi_leaflet")

output$aqi_leaflet <- renderLeaflet({
  leaflet() %>%
    addTiles() %>%
    setView(lng = -108, lat = 39, zoom = 5) %>%
    addLegend(
      position = "bottomright",
      colors = c("#00E400", "#FFFF00", "#FF7E00", "#FF0000"),
      labels = c("Good", "Moderate", "Unhealthy (Sensitive)", "Unhealthy"),
      title = "AQI Category"
    )
})

observe({
  df <- parks_aqi_data()
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return()
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      popup_html = paste0(
        "<b>", unit_name, "</b><br>",
        "State: ", state_full, "<br>",
        "Avg Median AQI: ", median_aqi, "<br>",
        "Category: <span style='color:", aqi_color, ";font-weight:bold;'>", aqi_category, "</span><br>",
        "<small>(Based on ", counties_reporting, " reporting counties)</small>"
      )
    )
  
  leafletProxy("aqi_leaflet", data = df) %>%
    clearMarkers() %>%
    addCircleMarkers(
      lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
      radius = 10,
      fillColor = ~aqi_color,
      color = "#333",
      weight = 1.5,
      fillOpacity = 0.85,
      popup = ~popup_html,
      label = ~paste(unit_name, "-", aqi_category)
    )
})
```

### Air Quality Summary by State

```{r aqi_table}
renderTable({
  req(input$aqi_year)
  
  # Get visitors for the year from TidyTuesday data (matching teammate's source)
  visitors <- im_parks %>%
    filter(year_num == input$aqi_year, unit_name != "Total Visitation") %>%
    mutate(state_full = case_when(
      unit_name %in% c("Yellowstone National Park", "Grand Teton National Park") ~ "Wyoming",
      unit_name %in% c("Rocky Mountain National Park", "Mesa Verde National Park", 
                       "Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park", "Great Sand Dunes National Park") ~ "Colorado",
      unit_name %in% c("Arches National Park", "Bryce Canyon National Park", "Canyonlands National Park",
                       "Capitol Reef National Park", "Zion National Park") ~ "Utah",
      unit_name %in% c("Grand Canyon National Park", "Petrified Forest National Park", 
                       "Saguaro National Park") ~ "Arizona",
      unit_name == "Carlsbad Caverns National Park" ~ "New Mexico",
      unit_name %in% c("Big Bend National Park", "Guadalupe Mountains National Park") ~ "Texas",
      unit_name == "Glacier National Park" ~ "Montana",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )) %>%
    filter(!is.na(state_full)) %>%
    group_by(state_full) %>%
    summarize(visitors = sum(visitors, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Build table with CORRECTED median AQI values
  air_im %>%
    filter(year == input$aqi_year) %>%
    left_join(visitors, by = c("state" = "state_full")) %>%
    transmute(
      State = state,
      `Median AQI` = median_aqi,  # Now correctly calculated!
      `Category` = aqi_category,
      `Counties Reporting` = counties_reporting,
      `Good Days` = formatC(good_days, big.mark = ","),
      `Unhealthy Days` = formatC(unhealthy_days, big.mark = ","),
      `Park Visitors` = ifelse(is.na(visitors), "—", formatC(visitors, big.mark = ","))
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(`Median AQI`))
    
}, striped = TRUE, hover = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)
```

### Pane 2- Interactive Visitation Trend for Denali National Park
```{r interactive_plot, warning = FALSE}

library(plotly)

demo <- park_visits %>% filter(str_detect(unit_name, "Denali"))

demo <- park_visits %>% 
  filter(str_detect(unit_name, "Denali")) %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))

demo_year <- demo %>% 
  pull(year) 

p <- ggplot(demo, aes(x = year, y = visitors)) +
     geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
     geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.6) +
     scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(demo_year, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                     max(demo_year, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                     by = 10)) +
     scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 200000)) + 
     labs(title = "Visitation Trend: Denali National Park",
          x = "Year",
          y = "Visitors")

ggplotly(p)

```
